faq.q1: How do I create my Flux account?
faq.a1: Click "Sign up" in the top right, then enter your email and a secure password. Confirm your email via the activation link sent to your inbox. Your account is ready!
faq.q2: How do I book a hotel or a place to stay?
faq.a2: Use the search bar to enter your destination and dates. Browse the results, pick your preferred accommodation, and click "Book". Follow the payment steps to confirm your booking.
faq.q3: How do I modify or cancel my booking?
faq.a3: Log in to your account, go to "My bookings" and select the relevant booking. Modification or cancellation options depend on the property's policy. Check the terms before proceeding.
faq.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a4: Flux accepts credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and digital wallets. All payments are secure and encrypted.
faq.q5: How do I contact the owner or the hotel?
faq.a5: Once your booking is confirmed, you can contact the owner directly through Flux messaging. For questions before booking, use the contact form on the listing.
faq.q6: How do I add my listing on Flux?
faq.a6: Create a professional account, go to your dashboard and click "New listing". Fill in your accommodation's details (description, price, availability, photos) and publish it.
faq.q7: Are there fees to list my property?
faq.a7: Creating a listing is free. Flux takes a commission on each confirmed booking. Check our rates in your professional dashboard.
faq.q8: How do I manage bookings and availability?
faq.a8: Your dashboard shows all bookings. You can update rates and availability in real time via the interactive management calendar.
faq.q9: How do I receive payments for bookings?
faq.a9: Set up your bank details in the payment settings. Funds are paid out automatically after each booking (timing depends on your bank).
faq.q10: How do I increase my listing's visibility?
faq.a10: Optimize your listing with quality photos, a detailed description, and competitive rates. Reply quickly to requests and encourage positive reviews to improve your ranking.
faq.q11: My account has been blocked. What should I do?
faq.a11: Check the email we sent you to find out why. Contact our support team for more details and possible solutions.
faq.q12: Is my data secure on Flux?
faq.a12: Yes, we use SSL encryption, two-factor authentication protection, and comply with GDPR standards to protect your personal data.
faq.q13: How do I change my password?
faq.a13: Log in to your account, go to "Settings" → "Security" and click "Change password". Follow the instructions sent by email to confirm.
faq.q14: I can't log in. What should I do?
faq.a14: Click "Forgot password?" to reset your password. If the problem persists, contact our support via the contact form.
faq.trouvez_reponses: Find answers to the most common questions about using Flux.
